title: Cartel
summary: A framed monochrome with a blank wall-label plate; the entire museum caption lives only in the native title-attribute tooltip, drawn and timed by the OS and absent on touch.
mechanism: The native title-attribute tooltip — OS-drawn, OS-timed, absent from the render tree and unavailable on touch (hover:none) — carries the whole wall label (title, medium, live viewport dimensions, price); per-visit hsl hue via Math.random held in a closure, no storage, no network.
references: Joseph Kosuth, Titled (Art as Idea as Idea) (1967)
Marcel Broodthaers, "Ceci n'est pas un objet d'art" / Musee d'Art Moderne, Departement des Aigles (1968-72)
Institutional critique / net.art (the title attribute as material)
